build_flash_lra_encoder: build a FlashLRAEncoder with sparse embeddings, 6 encoder layers, and scalenorm for masked language modeling
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through FlashLRAEncoder with token tensors and source lengths to get inner states and sentence representations
build_embedding_layer: build a sparse or linear embedding layer using FlashLRAEncoder build_embedding method with vocab size and embedding dim
build_final_norm_layer: build a final normalization layer using FlashLRAEncoder build_final_norm_layer with layernorm, scalenorm, or batchnorm type
normalize_encoder_output: normalize the encoder output tensor using FlashLRAEncoder normalize method with batch-aware permutation for batchnorm
